sourceFacts.fact: Unset enables; explicit false pauses only processes executing this implementation. No live gate configuration was applied by this analysis.

The durable intent precedes hosted-page creation, but returned provider uniq is persisted afterwards. A request/response crash can leave a pending intent without its known provider reference. Such a row is ambiguous, not evidence that no order exists.

The create-page request sets no explicit expiry. Reviewed client code exposes no cancellation/expiry API or merchant-wide complete order inventory. Source does not prove maximum page lifetime or terminal non-payability.

Paused callbacks return503 before financial processing; no durable incoming callback record is written. Ordinary non-pause errors still use incumbent200 behavior. No provider retry retention is certified.

Candidate shutdown forces exit after10seconds by default. It stops Central timer without awaiting flush and has no billing/welcome timer stop/join handle. ValidateNotification fetch has no explicit AbortSignal;20-second timers on other calls cannot establish a universal safe drain bound.

HTTP binds before asynchronous startup checks; literal health200 is not ready-state proof. Startup always calls external ipify before background gate. No payment-supplier call is required by the inspected explicit startup path, but whole import-graph zero-IO is not certified.
Signing uses its own worker flag before background gate. Integration demo and court-demo workers can run independently of backgroundfalse and can write data or dispatch notifications.
dotenv does not override process env. Plain named pm2 restart is not evidence that the effective child env was refreshed or that gatefalse won over stored env.

queries.aggregateIntents:
SELECT kind,status,count(*)::integer AS intents,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(takbull_uniq_id,'') IS NOT NULL)::integer AS hosted_refs,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(takbull_transaction_id,'') IS NOT NULL)::integer AS transaction_refs,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='pending' AND NULLIF(takbull_uniq_id,'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(takbull_transaction_id,'') IS NULL)::integer AS ambiguous_no_provider_ref,
 max(created_at) AS creation_high_water,max(updated_at) AS update_high_water
FROM public.firm_payment_intents
WHERE law_firm_tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $1::uuid
GROUP BY kind,status ORDER BY kind,status;
queries.boundedPrivateReferenceCursor:
SELECT id,kind,status,order_reference,takbull_uniq_id,takbull_transaction_id,amount_ils,currency,created_at
FROM public.firm_payment_intents
WHERE law_firm_tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $1::uuid
 AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR (created_at,id)>($2::timestamptz,$3::uuid))
ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 100;
queries.financialOutboxCounts:
SELECT event_family,status,count(*)::integer AS rows,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE lease_until>now())::integer AS live_leases,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='sending' AND lease_until<=now())::integer AS expired_sending_leases
FROM public.central_system_message_outbox
WHERE deployment_id=$1 AND office_key=$2
 AND event_family IN ('payment_received','subscription_update')
GROUP BY event_family,status ORDER BY event_family,status;
queries.supplementaryOwnRoleSessionCounts:
SELECT state,count(*)::integer AS sessions
FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname=current_database() AND usename=current_user AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()
GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;

limitations: Run both before cutover for planning and after freeze/drain for closure; prefreeze zero races.

Keep keys/request URLs/refs/raw responses/tokens/card/contact fields in memory, never logs orGit. Export only identity/amount/currency match booleans, statuses and complete-scope counts.
Use bounded timeout and redirect:error; no browser PaymentGateway load.
statusLimits: App verifier recognizes completedorder3 and exact approved cardtransaction1/statusCode0/type10/method3; this alone does not document page reuse/expiry semantics.

A reference lost before persistence needs proven pure order-reference lookup/merchant issuance inventory or authoritative expiry evidence; those contracts are absent from reviewed source.
Never infer sandbox/nonsettlement from TEST credential names, localmode or shared host.
